intro: Tapes I keep on repeat while I code, read papers and break things. Press a tape, hit play.

tracks.title: Friends (Intro loop)
tracks.note: My peak favourite. The second it starts, everything goes quiet and it's just me and the loop. I could leave it running forever.

tracks.title: Drugs & Money (Instrumental)
tracks.note: Heavy and dark in the best way. It pulls me into my own zone and I stop caring about everything else.

tracks.title: Slow Down (Instrumental)
tracks.note: Dreamy and a little sad. It slows everything down and I just drift for a while.

tracks.title: Blinding Lights (Instrumental)
tracks.note: Peak favourite. That rush the moment the synths hit, I'm somewhere else, pure feeling. It never gets old.

tracks.title: High For This (Instrumental)
tracks.note: Cold, slow and dark. It builds like a night you can't quite explain, and I'm happy to stay lost in it.
